card.name: Right after a negation, before 'any'
card.fires_on: The word right after a negative phrase (no kind of proof, Nor, never, hardly, not one of them), where 'any' or 'anything' is expected next. It marks a verb or linking word in a negated sentence.

modes.label: Linking word after 'no proof'
modes.description: A word such as 'that' follows a negated noun, leading into an 'any'-type clause.
modes.example: there is no kind of proof<< that>> the ancients had such a subtle poison

modes.label: Verb after Nor or never
modes.description: An auxiliary or verb comes right after 'Nor', 'never' or 'no wild wolf', before 'anyone' or 'a thing'.
modes.example: Nor<< has>> anyone ever seen a body at rest remain

modes.label: Verb in a negated instruction
modes.description: A verb in a prohibition where 'any' fits next.
modes.example: Do not let the tip of the tube<< touch>> your eye.

card.writes: It raises 'any', 'anything' and 'anyone' and lowers 'some' words, fitting a negative sentence.
card.plain: It fires in negated sentences where the next word is likely 'any' or 'anything' rather than 'some'.
